## The probes (the checker's own, mirror only)

* **NO-SHIFT dump** (`zz-probe.test.ts`, mirror only). It runs B-FUZZ seeds 1–20 × 7919 × 18 batches (the PR size), the
  cost model's 12 runs × 16, Q54's ALONG sequences (91, 235, 307, 719 and 980 × 104 729 × 20) and HEAVY sequences (106,
  210, 213, 333, 361, 395, 402, 443 and 739 × 15 485 863 × 20), and fuzz.test's 100 warp cases. Every batch goes
  through `suiteEnv`. For each batch it writes one line: the outcome, the suite's batch line (each row's holds, subjects,
  problems and meters), `allProblems`, `checkCI` and `checkBatch(wholeRecord)`. That gives 933 lines. The pre-round
  sources and the tree's sources give byte-identical files (sha-256 `ce56e5ecc5a31e84…` both). CONFIRMED.
* **Refusal census (J264, N-58), before = after:** 750 committed, 182 refused. Of the refused, 178 are E_KEPT, in four
  forms: a chain vertex inside a finer face ×161, would split a finer face ×13, would cross a finer edge ×3, and within
  attractCm of a finer edge ×1. These are insertChain's kept-content refusals. Their class is M0-a-05's open reading
  (`checks/M0-a-06-notes.md` N-c1-2), not this item's, and is unchanged. The other 4 are E_INVARIANT, stretch's
  role-parts refusal `(way, …) lies in N parts … split it by rekey first`: UNLAWFUL, REFUSE, with the alternative named
  (rekey). No refusal names a suite row. In the suite's batch lines, hard-row failures are role-consistency ×4 (the same 4
  batches) and nothing else. face-corners is soft. The count of lawful-input refusals did not rise. CONFIRMED.
* **Stacked Steiner offsets** (for the pad survivors). In 300 random slivers, an L1 route has a slope of 1–12 cm over
  40 m, and L2, L3 and L4 chains end on it at random lattice points within ±1 cm of the route. In 400 nested arenas,
  L2 ⊃ L3 ⊃ L4 chains end on one L1 run (1 600 L4 chains committed). Together these give 177 562 `faceLeftOf` calls
  against the exhaustive truth. Pad 0 misses 6 207 times. Pads 1, 2 and 3 each miss 0. This confirms Q56's class is
  easy to reach by construction. It also shows no reachable input on which pad 1 or 2 differs from the reach (N-s3-1;
  N-s3c-1). The constructions' own setup refusals are all E_KEPT kept-content, from coarser chains inserted beside
  finer ones with no clear: within attractCm of a finer vertex ×340, of a finer edge ×101, inside a finer face ×1 217,
  would share a finer edge ×1. That is the class above, not this item's. CONFIRMED.
